tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, sticky table heads, inputs and the inset blocks of the detail panel (situation, gates, runs, drafts) and the timeline's messages.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: top bar, detail panel, cards, KPI tiles, chart panels, buttons.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, rail items and cards; also the neutral pill ground.

tokens.name: sel
tokens.usage: Selected or pressed state: current rail view, pressed chips and toggles, selected task, your own messages in the timeline.

tokens.name: mine-bg
tokens.usage: Row and card ground for pull requests you opened.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface token and on `mark`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, counts, timestamps, section overlines, column heads. Reads on every surface plus `late-bg` and `err-bg`.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: row dividers, panel and control borders, dashed timeline separators, the bar beside an ask's quote. Decorative only; it never carries meaning.

tokens.name: me
tokens.usage: Waits on you. Strip and dot of a row whose next step is yours, and the edge of an open gate; also the app's accent: primary button fill, focus ring, current-view marker, the mark's bar. Mark contrast 4.6:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: author
tokens.usage: Waits on the author. Strip of rows whose next step is the pull request author's.

tokens.name: reviewer
tokens.usage: Waits on a reviewer other than you. Strip and chart series.

tokens.name: loop
tokens.usage: Waits on the loop: an agent round is running or due. Strip, chart series, positive signals. Light theme is 4.1:1 on `sel` and `mine-bg`, above the 3:1 floor for marks.

tokens.name: none
tokens.usage: Waits on nobody. Strip of idle rows. Intentionally faint: 1.6 to 1.9:1 on light surfaces and 2.2 to 2.7:1 in dark, below the 3:1 mark floor; the row's `who` text in `none-text` carries the meaning.

tokens.name: me-text
tokens.usage: Text in the `me` hue: the `who` cell, external links, countdowns, a changed task's title. On every surface.

tokens.name: author-text
tokens.usage: Text in the `author` hue (the `who` cell). On every surface.

tokens.name: reviewer-text
tokens.usage: Text in the `reviewer` hue (the `who` cell). On every surface.

tokens.name: loop-text
tokens.usage: Text in the `loop` hue: `who` cell, loop events in timelines, pending plan items, done review steps, good signals. On every surface.

tokens.name: none-text
tokens.usage: Text for the `nobody` waiter. On every surface.

tokens.name: on-me
tokens.usage: Text on a `me` fill (primary button). Dark in the dark theme because `me` lightens there.

tokens.name: mine-text
tokens.usage: The `mine` flag text on any surface.

tokens.name: late
tokens.usage: Late: an age past the stalled threshold, the Stalled count, held or observe-mode labels, medium risk, starred tasks. On every surface and on `late-bg`.

tokens.name: late-bg
tokens.usage: Ground behind a late age chip and the medium-risk tag.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Errors and high risk: failed actions, blocked plan items, warning banner text, bad signals. On `err-bg` and `panel`.

tokens.name: err-bg
tokens.usage: Warning banner ground and the high-risk tag ground.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Search-match highlight behind `ink`.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Add retry budget to the webhook consumer

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two comments resolved, one question left for you.
styles.usage: Default UI and prose text, including asks, gates, drafts and the timeline's messages.

styles.name: row-title
styles.sample: Add retry budget to the webhook consumer
styles.usage: The title of a row, card, task or candidate.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Secondary lines, buttons, facts, timelines; always in `muted` unless a state color applies.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section labels in the rail, detail panel and activity days. Set uppercase.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The product name in the top bar, after the `me` bar glyph.

styles.name: age-lg
styles.usage: The clock in the detail panel's situation block.

styles.name: age
styles.usage: How long a row has waited.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Refs, counts, timestamps, event data, sync status, commands.

styles.name: flag
styles.usage: Uppercase outlined flags on a meta line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside cards between title and meta; facet padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and pills; rail item block padding; timeline row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Table cell block padding; gap between action buttons; card list gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Table cell inline padding; card and candidate padding; toolbar block padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Inset block padding (situation, gates, runs, drafts) block axis; the inline padding of a timeline message and of an ask's quote; panel inline padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Board lane gap; inset block inline padding; space before a sub-section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page gutter: top bar, list, toolbar, detail panel inline padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; bottom of the detail panel.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Search-match highlight.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Flags, late age chips, facet focus.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, gates, runs, drafts, timeline messages, candidates.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: KPI tiles and dashboard panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, pills and review step pickers.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Left rail column.

tokens.name: detail-width
tokens.usage: Default detail panel width; the reader can drag it.

tokens.name: strip-row
tokens.usage: Waits-on strip on table rows, group heads and the situation block; the edge of an open gate and the bar beside an ask's quote.

tokens.name: strip-card
tokens.usage: Waits-on strip on board cards, candidates, tasks and the current rail view.

tokens.name: breakpoint-narrow
tokens.usage: Below it the rail becomes a wrapped tab row, the detail panel stacks under the list and Why and Where columns hide.

tokens.name: breakpoint-phone
tokens.usage: Below it brief tags leave the meta line.

tokens.name: state-glyph
tokens.usage: The glyph of a task's state category, its click target padded to 24px on touch.
